coverage_notes: Static evidence does not prove runtime use or absence of crypto.
Lexical C/C++ analysis; no preprocessing, inactive-branch evaluation, macro expansion, variable-selector or data-flow analysis.
The general source reference engine requires an exact pinned module SHA-256. Guomi has a separate bounded operation-witness engine for selected C/C++ bodies; unknown names alone remain clues.

Source operation graphs resolve bounded local header macros/scalar helpers at actual call sites; no full preprocessing. Evidence describes available source operations, not enabled compiled or runtime use.
